 Bench At Aurangabad

High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad

sentences.text:
77 Writ Petition No. 633 Of 2018
 Kacharu Bhanudas Wankhare And Another
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Others

With
 Writ Petition No. 613 Of 2018
 Gujaba Manaji Wankhare
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Others
Mr.Abhishek Nagode, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mrs.K.B.Patil Bharaswadkar, Addl.G.P. for the respondent/State.
Mr.G.S.Khaire h/f Mr.S.S.Dande, Advocate for respondent No.4.
( Coram : Kishore C. Sant And Sushil M. Ghodeswar, Jj. )

Per
Court :
1. Inspite of order dated 09.03.2026, no reply is filed by respondent No.4 till today.
2.  The petition is in respect of seeking compensation of the land as per the market rate of the year 2016.
The representation was made to the respondent S.D.O./Special Land Acquisition Officer.
The S.L.A.O., by communication dated 25.02.2016 had replied that the representation stating the market rate as on the date of notification u/s 32(2) of the M.I.D.C. Act, is to be granted.

It is the case of the petitioners that the respondent, by agreement dated 11.03.2016 had agreed that the compensation would be paid towards the fruit bearing trees and the construction as on market value in the year 2016.

It is seen that the agreement is also signed by the learned S.D.O.,
Aurangabad.
3. We, therefore, direct the Government to file the affidavit in reply by the next date.
The reply be positively filed before the next date by giving copy well in advance to the other side in both these petitions.

( SUSHIL M. GHODESWAR, J.) ( KISHORE C. SANT, J.)
